***
## Undergrad and Master thesis 


I am interested in supervising and collaborating with students who are motivated by research. If you are planning to undertake a Bachelor’s or Master’s thesis (TFG, TFM, in spanish), I would be delighted to discuss a potential research proposal linked to my research lines and tailored to your academic interests.

I usually have topics related to my projects. Please, feel free to email me if you are interested in any [line of research](https://chefaoui.github.io/index.html#Research_Lines). Some of my students are shown here: [URJC Teaching web page](https://gestion2.urjc.es/pdi/ver/rosa.chefaoui) (see "Trabajos de fin de estudios").

***
## PhD students and Postdocs

Please browse [Publications](https://chefaoui.github.io/Research.html) and [Projects]to find matching research interests.

Sending your CV and a short letter explaining how our research interests could fit would be ideal.

We could attempt some of the European Union, Comunidad de Madrid, Spanish Ministry, URJC and/or IICG job opportunities.
